cards.title: Dark chocolate + strawberries
cards.why: Real chocolate, plus fruit. Dark chocolate has some magnesium, which some people find helps with cramps.

cards.title: Hot cocoa made with milk
cards.why: Warm, chocolatey and cozy, with a little calcium and protein from the milk.

cards.title: Dark chocolate almonds
cards.why: Chocolate and crunch together. Almonds bring magnesium and staying power.

cards.title: Frozen banana dipped in chocolate
cards.why: Tastes like an ice cream bar. Bananas have potassium and vitamin B6.

cards.title: Chocolate milk
cards.why: Sweet, cold and quick, with protein to keep you going.

cards.title: Greek yogurt, honey and berries
cards.why: Creamy and sweet, with protein that keeps you full longer.

cards.title: Frozen grapes
cards.why: Like tiny sorbet bites. Sweet, icy and refreshing.

cards.title: Dates with peanut butter
cards.why: Tastes like caramel. Dates bring fiber and a little iron.

cards.title: Apple slices + peanut butter
cards.why: Sweet, crunchy and creamy at once.

cards.title: Berry and spinach smoothie
cards.why: Cold, sweet and thick. You won't taste the spinach, but it adds iron.

cards.title: Popcorn with sea salt
cards.why: Big bowl, lots of crunch, and it's a whole grain.

cards.title: Roasted chickpeas
cards.why: Crunchy and salty like chips, with protein and iron.

cards.title: Salted edamame
cards.why: Warm, salty and poppable. Protein and iron in every handful.

cards.title: Trail mix with pumpkin seeds
cards.why: Sweet, salty and crunchy. Pumpkin seeds are high in magnesium and iron.

cards.title: Cheese and whole-grain crackers
cards.why: The salty, crunchy combo, with protein from the cheese.

cards.title: Pickles or olives
cards.why: Salty fast. Sometimes that's all the craving wants.

cards.title: Rice cakes with avocado and chili flakes
cards.why: Crunchy, creamy and a little spicy.

cards.title: Oatmeal with cinnamon and banana
cards.why: Warm, filling carbs that give steady energy instead of a crash.

cards.title: Toast with peanut butter and honey
cards.why: Carbs and comfort. The peanut butter keeps you full longer.

cards.title: Pasta with spinach and parmesan
cards.why: A big cozy bowl. Spinach adds iron, which matters around your period.

cards.title: Microwave sweet potato
cards.why: Butter, cinnamon, done. Sweet, warm and filling.

cards.title: Instant ramen with an egg and greens
cards.why: Brothy, salty comfort. The egg and greens add protein and iron.

cards.title: Ginger tea with honey
cards.why: Warm and soothing. Ginger may ease period pain and queasiness for some people.

cards.title: Cup of miso soup
cards.why: Warm and salty in two minutes.

cards.title: Frozen yogurt bark
cards.why: Yogurt, berries and dark chocolate chips, frozen and snapped.
